description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which provides CRUD operations for notes and categories within an Android application's data layer, interacting with an SQLite database.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data access methods for notes and categories, encapsulating database interactions for CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, optionally filtered by category ID.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches for notes containing the query string in title or content.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note; returns the number of rows affected.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: getAllCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all categories sorted by name.

methods.name: insertCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category; returns its ID, or existing ID if already present.

methods.name: renameCategory
methods.description: Renames an existing category; returns number of rows affected.

methods.name: getCategoryNameById
methods.description: Returns the category name for a given ID, or 'None' if not found.
